posts.headline: Statistic
posts.body:
Collagen production decreases by 1% every year after age 20.
By 50, you've lost 30% of your skin's structural support.
posts.cta: You're losing collagen every year after 20.

posts.headline: Statistic
posts.body:
50% of heart attacks occur in people with normal cholesterol.
Inflammation, not just cholesterol, is the real risk factor.
posts.cta: Half of heart attacks happen to 'healthy' people.
